name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabs whose indicator stretches toward the new tab with its leading edge while the trailing edge catches up. Arrow keys, Home and End, panels without layout shift.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Tabs from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsPanels, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/motion-tabs".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-tabs.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createTabs on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/tabs/tabs.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#tabs
